newsitem.title: USA: Fed biased in favor of growth -- Rivlin.
newsitem.headline: Fed biased in favor of growth -- Rivlin.

text.p: Federal Reserve Vice Chair Alice Rivlin said on Wednesday that the U.S. central bank's primary goal was to foster growth at its highest possible sustainable rate.
"We're biased in favor of growth. That's what we think we're doing," she told the House Banking committee in testimony.
"The highest sustainable rate of growth is what the Fed is really trying to achieve," she said, adding it was unclear where exactly that rate was.
